snippet.title: Rager - Official Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Here's your look at combat, enemies, and more from Rager in this trailer for the upcoming music-action brawler that throws you into epic battles where you fight like a superhero. Set in a dark, digital realm that builds itself around you, each world emerges from the void to test your skill and dissolves once the battle is won. Every moment is powered by intense music that sharpens your senses and pulls you deeper into the fight. Rager is coming to Early Access on Meta Quest and Steam VR in fall 2025. A demo is available now.
